model: TUDOR Black Bay 54 M79000N-0001 (37 mm steel, black dial, steel bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Black Bay 54 template (the rubber-strap M79000N-0002 changes model, note, trace, dial_map, steel_map, strap and, if needed, dial emission): case, bezel (insert + coin edge), crown and hands from the 37 mm photo silhouette; the black dial, indices, print and minute track come from one 2x photo map with the photographed hands left in it.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (the lugs rise above the round bezel); top slopes toward the strap

bezel.note: steel coin-edge ring (bezel_in..bezel_out) around the black insert (bezel_in..insert_out); numerals, markers and triangle come from the projected photo

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, 0.06 mm wider than the photographed hands so the 3D hands hide the ones in the map; the last point sits at the traced length. lume = +w side outline [s, w] of the lume polygon, mirrored about the axis (hour: stem strip + snowflake diamond, minute: strip, seconds: disc). Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: no crown guards on the Black Bay 54

strap.note: strap.kind selects the section built from strap[kind]: 'bracelet' (M79000N-0001) or 'rubber' (M79000N-0002, placeholders)

bracelet.note: Flat bracelet of three brushed columns. Joints (dark lines) read from the photo with brightness scans, top and bottom separately: outer columns top y 243 (end piece), bottom 957.5 (lug bottom) / 1083.5; centre column top 373 / 311 / 219, bottom 931 / 1006 / 1100.5 (photo px, listed as mm from the pivot at 13.946 px/mm). The first pieces run under the case. centre_x_mm = the vertical joint lines between the columns, [|y|, left x, right x] (x 389 / 510 at the top, 390 -> 393.5 / 510 -> 508.5 toward the bottom end). Rivet ears at the sides come from the alpha silhouette.

rubber.note: PLACEHOLDER for M79000N-0002 (not built here): one continuous column over the silhouette; list transverse grooves / end pieces per side in pieces_mm.strap, measure the y ranges (mm from the pivot) on the -0002 photo

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
